A collection of  Shadowheart's remarks and voicebarks in various locations or plot scenes throughout the game. In some party combinations, a particular party member (including Custom Origin (Tav)) have the priority to voice their line. In these cases, Shadowheart's line is not used at all, or she utters a responding remark, if there is any.

At some points, the locations remarks are common for all possible party members, including Custom Origin (Tav). These are not included here. However, the responses for them can be unique for Shadowheart and thus are included.

Also, some lines provided for Shadowheart initially (as well as for other party members) have been cut during further development, or may not appear due to basic voicebarks replacing them (for example, on ability checks).

Prologue

Nursery and Surgery

  • (Coming to senses near a Mind Flayer Pod[1]): "What? Where am I...?"
    • (Responding remark): "Wherever this is, I don't intend to linger."
  • (Interacted with her own pod, 1): "That's the last time I want to see the inside of one of those."
    • (Interacted with her own pod, 2): "Damn thing. A coffin would be more inviting."
  • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 1): "Empty."
    • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 2): "Someone else made it, then."
    • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 3): "Someone else got out from this."
    • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 4): "Another escapee."
  • (Interacted with any other ruptured pod in the room, 1): "I suppose I should count my blessings."
    • (Interacted with any other ruptured pod in the room, 2): "This could have been me."
    • (Interacted with any other ruptured pod in the room, 3): "Burned alive..."
  • (Looked out from the hull breach): "The Nine Hells. That's as close as I'd like to get..."
  • (Looted a dead Mind Flayer): "Dead. Hopefully most of its friends are in the same condition."
  • (Used the Restoration): "What is this thing? I feel... better? How?"
  • (After the first fight with the Lesser Imps): "That's that. Got to keep moving." (triggers only if Lae'zel or Losiir[2] are not in the party, otherwise their line will be played)
  • (Saw a dragon on the way to upper deck): "We need to keep pushing forward - I don't want to test how much punishment this ship can take."
  • (Interacting with the Tentacle Aquarium for the first time): "Brains...? Not the strangest thing I've seen today, unfortunately."
    • (After the first time): "Ugh. More of these things."
  • (Interacting with Cerebral Aquarium for the first time): "Better not get too close - might be toxic."
  • (After the first time): "Where the hells are these from?"

Ceremorphosis Chamber

  • (Upon entering the chamber, saw the control panel): "What is all this...? Better be careful what I touch." (played only if Lae'zel hasn't entered the room with the player character, otherwise her line will be played)
  • (Trying to read the central sigil,  Arcana check failed): "What's this gibberish?"
  • (Trying to read the left sigil, Arcana failed): "Well, this isn't enlightening."
  • (Trying to read the right sigil, Arcana failed): "Means nothing to me."
  • (Used 'Unleash' button): "Dead. Nothing to be done."
  • (Used 'Aggression' button): "My own fault for pulling strange levers I suppose..."
  • (Try to open the Elaborate Reliquary without a key): "Locked. Might be a key somewhere..."
    • (Found the Gold Key): "A key... Haven't seen anywhere this might fit."
  • (Found the Eldritch Rune): “I haven't seen anywhere for something like this to fit...”
    • (Found the key, already tried to open the chest): "This must be for that chest."
  • (Saw dozens of pods in the Transformation room): "So many pods. Are they all infected...?" (played only if Lae'zel hasn't entered the room with the player character, otherwise her line will be played)
  • (Trying to read the button in Transformation room,  Arcana failed): "Don't know what that says. Don't know if it's even writing."
  • (Saw the woman in the pod transformed): "Hells. Is that going to happen to us...?"
    • (Responding remark, as a party member): "That could have been me, if you hadn't gotten me out of my pod..."
  • (Sat in one of the chairs surrounding the pod in Transformation room): Are those... voices?"
    • (Responding remark 1): "I don't hear anything. Are you losing your mind already?"
    • (Responding remark 2): "The chair - it must connecting you to the mind flayers."
    • (Responding remark 3): "Let's go, before they realise we're loose."
  • (Picked up either Slave Mind or Dark Mind): "A brain. No thank you, I have one already."
    • (Picked up the second one of these two): "Another brain."
  • (As a party member, after she has been freed from the pod 1): "At last... thought I was done for."
    • (Freed from the pod 2): "How long was I in there...?"
    • (Freed from the pod 3): "I thought I was going to die in that blasted tube."
    • (Freed from the pod 4): "Got to get up. Got to keep moving."

The Helm

  • (In Multiplayer regime, if another player has entered the Helm, while Shadowheart hasn't yet): "This ship won't stay aloft forever - need to hurry."
  • (On the third turn of the fight in the Helm): "This thing's falling fast - got to right it."
  • (On the fifth turn of the fight in the Helm): "Nearly out of sky - it's now or never."
  • (Mind Flayer turns on the party after killing Commander Zhalk): "Well that's gratitude for you. TIme to leave."
  • (Mind Flayer died in the fight with cambions): "The imps killed that thing. Time to get out of here..."
  • (Mind Flayer and cambions dead, player character reminds themselves of the transponder): "I need to get to that transponder."

Act One

Ravaged Beach and Roadside Cliffs

  • (Near the docks): "There's bound to be a settlement somewhere along this river..."
  • (Encountering Intellect Devourers in the Nautiloid Wreck): "Vicious filth. Best keep some distance, or this'll be a short fight..."
  • (Approaching the dying mind flayer in the Nautiloid Wreck): "That thing's bound to be dangerous, even if injured. Best be careful."
  • (Approaching unstable rune - the point of Gale’s recruitment): “Something's amiss with that rune. Seems unstable.”
  • (Saw Losiir's dead body): “Our gith helper didn't make it. So how were we spared...?”
  • (Saw dead goblins near the crash site): “Dead goblins over there. Worth checking for supplies maybe.”
  • (Saw Lae'zel caged by tieflings): "A githyanki. She ought to be killed, here and now."

Overgrown Ruins and the Dank Crypt

  • (When found bashing on the Dank Crypt door, 1): "They can't hold forever. Come on!"
    • (Bashing on the Dank Crypt door, 2): "Blessed Mother, smite the obstacles in my path."
    • (Bashing on the Dank Crypt door, 3): "Bloody doors!"
    • (Bashing on the Dank Crypt door, 4): "Why?! Why won't you just open?!"
  • (Lockpicked the entrance to the crypt): “There! Not so impregnable after all.”
    • (Another player character lockpicked it): “What, you got it open, just like that...?”
  • (Respond to the player character’s successfully convincing the looters to flee): “You're more cunning than you look. I thought we had a fight on our hands.”
  • (Entering the crypt from the Refectory): "Abandoned. Whatever god this place was built for can't be in great demand."
    • (Responding remark): “Who were those prayers for? Normally the patron god is obvious - not here.”
  • (Looked at Jergal's statue in the crypt,  Religion check):
    • (Successful): "Jergal? I didn't think anyone worshipped the Scribe of the Dead."
    • (Failed): "Who's this supposed to be? Statue looks ancient."
  • (Saw the skeletons): "They look like scribes, despite the weapons. No wonder they're dead."
    • (Respond to any player character’s voicebark when the skeletons awoke): “Let them come. The darkness can be to our advantage.”
  • (After skeletons have been defeated): "Fools. Rising from the dead just to protect some dusty old baubles." ‘’ Serves also as a (Responding remark)’’
  • (Sneaked past enlivened skeletons): “They looked formidable enough. Lucky they didn't catch us with their loot.”
    • (Responding remark): “Their trinkets may be worth a few coins, all the same.”
  • (Ran away, escaped from the crypt): “They fought hard, for bone piles. We were lucky to escape with their loot.”
  • (Found the Book of Dead Gods): "What could a book contain that requires it to be bound with chains...?"
  • (Found a Soul Coin): "Is this... iron? What kind of currency is this?"
  • (Entering the locked part of the crypt): "Looks like nobody's ventured this far down in years..."

Emerald Grove and The Hollow

Approaching the Grove:

  • (After defeating first pack of goblins): “Well, that was bracing.”
    • (Responding remark 1): "They were tenacious. I wonder what they wanted here - other than bloodshed."
    • (Responding remark 2): “There must be more, wherever they came from.”

Resolving the initial confrontation between Aradin and Zevlor:

  • (Aradin was knocked out by Zevlor): “If only they had the same vigour fighting goblins as they did each other...”
  • (Zevlor was knocked out by Aradin): “If only he'd fought the goblins with the same vigour he had for that tiefling...”
    • (Responding remark to any of leaders' punch): “Let's check for a healer, then move on. Whatever else is happening here isn't our concern.”
  • (Aradin was knocked out by a player character): “Nice punch, though be careful you don't spoil our welcome before we get what we need.”
  • (Zevlor was knocked out by a player character): “ I hope that wasn't a healer you just knocked out.”
    • (Responding remark to any of player character’s punches): “Now that introductions are out of the way, perhaps we can look for a healer.”
  • (Respond to a player character's remark on the non-lethal ending of Aradin/Zevlor conflict): “Never mind their history. Let's look for help.”
  • (Reaction to Zevlor’s words about more goblins): “You heard them. More goblins could be on their way.”
    • (Responding remark): “Goblins aren't our concern, so long as they stay out of our way. We're here to find a healer.”

Resolving Sazza's fate:

  • (After Sazza told the party about Priestess Gut): “Goblins aren't exactly renowned healers, but we can't afford to ignore any options.”
    • (Responding remark): “Perhaps this Gut creature stole something that could be useful. A scroll, a potion, a cranial extractor.”
  • (Helped Sazza escape from the grove): “Freeing a goblin? Surely that's the tadpole, reworking my mind...”
    • (Responding remark): “I'm not in the habit of helping vermin. I expect it to return and bite.”
  • (Let Arka shoot Sazza): “Hardly a winning display of archery, but it did the job.”
    • (Responding remark): “Nobody will shed any tears for a dead goblin. The opposite, more likely. Let's move on.”

In the Sacred Pool and the Inner Sanctum:

  • (If Arabella was killed by Teela during the trial): “They killed a child, for that...? Let's get in and out of this place before any vipers decide to bare their fangs at us.”
    • (Responding remark): “We... can't help everyone. Even if we want to.”
  • (Saw the mural in the druid’s caves): “That mural... they look like Dark Justiciars.”
    • (Saw the mural in the druid’s caves, suspects of Dark Justiciar activity in the region): “That mural shows Dark Justiciars. All these signs can't be a coincidence.”
  • (In Halsin’s chamber, saw a dead drow): “A dead drow. These druids aren't to be tangled with lightly.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “There's a tadpole too, pickling in a jar.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “ Quite the statue. A formidable piece of stonework.”
    • (Responding remark 3): “Seems like the domain of a well-versed scholar - and not a squeamish one at that.”
  • (Read Halsin’s research on tadpoles): “This 'Halsin' person seems to know a lot about tadpoles.”
    • (Responding remark): “Got to find him then. See if he can help.”
  • (Read Halsin’s research on tadpoles, knows druid’s missing): “Halsin sounds like the best chance of finding a cure.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “Time to track him down and see what he knows.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “Assuming he's even still alive.”
    • (Responding remark 3): “He won't get off that easily. We can force his corpse to talk if it comes to that.”
  • (Opened the druids’ library with the magical circlet): “That did the trick.”
  • (Saw a magic-imbued glaive in druids’ library, knows the story): “This is the weapon mentioned in the notebook. Supposed to be cursed...”
    • (Haven’t read about the weapon’s story): “There's something off about this glaive. Touched with magic, or... something.”

Dealing with Nettie:

  • (Nettie locked the party up after they refused to take Wyvern Poison): “Could have been worse, I suppose. At least she didn't just attack.”
    • (Responding remark): “Blind honesty is always a bad idea. We should keep quiet in future.”
  • (Feeling sick after Nettie scratched them with a poisonous thorn): “Whatever Nettie did to me... it's getting worse.”
    • (Sickness getting worse after LR without cure): “Agh... I need to reverse whatever Nettie did to me, before it's too late.”
    • (Almost dying after second LR without cure): “Agh... killed by a bloody dwarf healer. Pathetic.”
    • (Cured from Nettie’s poison): “Poison's faded. Just my luck to find a healer, only to have her try to kill me.”
  • (Agreed to take Wyvern poison from Nettie): “Wyvern poison. Never tried it, and I hope to keep it that way.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “Better than becoming a mind flayer, I suppose. Keep it - in case things start to go very wrong.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “Better than becoming a mind flayer. Keep it - in case things start to go very wrong.”
    • (Responding remark 3): “Better to have more options than fewer. If you start sprouting tentacles, I'll pour it down your throat myself.”

In the Secluded Cove:

  • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 1): "Such splendour... how did I live without it?"
    • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 2): “So beautiful. Like Shar's embrace...”
    • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 3): “Sing your dark hymn to me, Shar. Never stop.”
    • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 4): “Such sweet music... I must listen...”
  • (Broke the Harpy's charm): "Foul winged charlatan! Your tricks will cost you!"

Elsewhere in The Hollow:

  • (Saw the Strange Ox): "That ox seems a little too interested in me..."
  • (Watching at the map in Zevlor’s cave): “Elturgard? A lot of territory to cover before Baldur's Gate - and any cure found there.”
    • (Responding remark): “These little markings look like goblins and gnolls - right in our path.”
  • (Near statue in the Underground Passage): "I don't think that statue's eyes are glowing to provide illumination. Best be careful."
  • (Found malnourished Torchstalks behind the Makeshift Prison): "Something tells me I should give that mushroom a wide berth."
  • (Found dead tiefling children after goblins' attack on the grove): “This is what we sowed. Shar's darkness will embrace the children now.”
  • (Found the vines all around the grove blocking the entrance): “Impressive, as weeds go.”
    • (Found the vines all around the grove, knows about Rite of Thorns): “All entrances sealed tight.”
  • (Tried to attack the vines): “I won't be getting through these things - nor will anyone else.”

The Forest and the Owlbear Nest

  • (Dealt with Andrik and Brynna, not knowing about the cult of Absolute): “Absolute? True what? What were those raving fools on about?”
    • (Responding remark): “They're clearly devoted to the Absolute. Whatever that is.”
  • (Heard about the cult previously from Sazza): “They spoke of the Absolute, same as that captive goblin. They must be part of the same sect.”
    • (Responding remark): “Looks like the Absolute's drawing all sorts to become followers. Impressive, in a way.”
  • (Saw Edowin’s tadpole exerting from his body): “That tadpole wasted no time in abandoning its host. Not sentimental creatures, clearly.”
  • (Responding remark): “All the more reason to rid ourselves of our own uninvited guests.”
  • (Found Exsanguinated Boar): “Curious. No wounds on that boar, but doesn't quite look like it died peacefully either…”
  • (Healed the Mother Owlbear): “Beast still looks murderous. Not sure it appreciates the healing touch...”
  • (Found Mother Owlbear killed by goblins, if the party have spared her earlier): “Seems like a pack of goblins swarmed the owlbear.”
  • (Responding remark): “Not a fate I'd wish on any creature.”
  • (Found a shrine to Selûne,  Religion check):
    • (Successful): "Looks like a shrine to Selûne over there."
    • (Failed): "Looks like there's a little shrine over there."
    • (Successful, if it’s already known she’s a Sharran): "A Selûne statue? In a stinking cave? Hardly a place of honour, even for the likes of her."
    • (Failed, if it’s already known she’s a Sharran): "A Selûne statue? In a stinking cave? Hardly a place of honour."
  • (Near the magically sealed chest): "There's magic at play here - a spell keeping this chest shut."
  • (Found a Selûnite Prayer Sheet,  Investigation check):
    • (Successful): “A Selûnite prayer. Marked with the same symbol as the chest. I'll have to sully my tongue and recite it.”
    • (Failed): “A prayer and a symbol. Perhaps it does more than just flatter Selûne…”
    • (Tried to open without disarming magical seal): “Agh! There's magic guarding this thing...”
    • (Opened the chest by reading the prayer): “That's it? A few pious words and the magic's dispelled?”
    • (Opened the chest as a Selûnite): “Moonmaiden's Grace! It's open!”
    • (Failed to recite the prayer): “Nothing but empty words, clearly.”
  • (Picked up the scroll with the Selûnite Rite): "Selûnite coming-of-age rites? Barbaric nonsense."
    • (If the party does not know she’s Sharran): “Worthless.”

Sunlit Wetlands/Putrid Bog

Dealing with Demir and Johl:

  • (Saw Auntie Ethel disappeared after helping her against brothers): "Magic? Ethel is less helpless she made out. I don't trust her."
    • (Responding remark): “I'd be happy to be wrong, but she makes my skin crawl. Watch yourself around her.”
  • (Found the brothers dead, haven’t met them): “These two were made to suffer, whoever they were.”
    • (Responding remark): “Whoever or whatever did this could still be around...”
    • (Have encountered them prior, arguing with Ethel): “These two won't be helping their sister. Or doing anything else, for that matter.”
    • (Responding remark): "Whoever did this wanted them to suffer. We need to be careful."

At the Druid Sanctuary/Decrepit Sanctuary:

  • (Noticed the knife-damaged tree bark): “There's a hollow in that tree... looks hand-carved.”
    • (Saw the damaged bark, knowing about Kagha’s letter): “This looks like the tree mentioned in Kagha's note.”
  • (Read Kagha’s recruitment letter from Shadow Druids): “Shadow Druids... it seems Kagha's been keeping secrets.”
    • (Responding remark): “Useful information. Or dangerous. Both, likely.”
    • (Read the letter before meeting Kagha): “Seems like some Shadow Druids turned someone called 'Kagha' to their cause.”

Elsewhere in the Wetlands/Bog:

  • (Found a sword and a helmet in the middle of the bog X: -3 Y: 277): “Rather fine blade and hat. Left behind by some unfortunate adventure-seeker, perhaps.”
  • (Tried to pick a fruit from a Barbed Bulrush, pricked a finger): “Owh! That smarts.”
  • (Found a slaughtered campsite on the riverbank): "Unlucky choice of campsite, judging by all the blood."
    • ( Nature check, successful): “Redcaps. They certainly made a mess here…”
    • (Failed): “Whatever did this must've worked itself into quite a frenzy.”
  • (After defeating Gandrel, stood by Astarion): "Speaking truthfully, I'm a little surprised you chose to shield Astarion".
    • (Responding remark): “He's not without his uses - as long as we can keep him in line.”
  • (Betrayed Astarion to Gandrel): “Vampire spawn or not, I'm surprised you actually surrendered Astarion like that…”
    • (Responding remark): “He was interesting company, all things considered. Pretty, arrogant, and bitey. Like a cat.”

In the Riverside Teahouse/Gnarled Teahouse:

  • (Near the fireplace in hag’s house,  Investigation check):
    • (Successful): “An illusion - with a passage hidden behind it.”
    • (Failed): “No time to be warming myself by a fire.”
  • (After Ethel didn’t succeed to extract the tadpole): “Bad enough to have a tadpole, never mind one that's been tampered with.”
    • (Responding remark): “We need to keep looking for a way to get rid of these things - they've overstayed their welcome as it is.”
  • (Ethel fled from the house, peaceful encounter): “Off to find someone else to ensnare in her dealings, no doubt.”
    • (Ethel fled from the house escaping a combat): “Now where has she slithered off to...?”
  • (Reached out to Connor’s coffin while the hag is still alive): “Agh! That stings.”
    • (Tried to touch it second time): “Agh! Still stings... don't know what else I expected.”

In the Overgrown Tunnel and the Ancient Abode:

  • (Chasing after Ethel through the illusory fireplace): “Where's that hag scurried off to now...?”
  • (Entering the Entrance Gallery): “Such charming aesthetics this place has.”
  • (After speaking with Lorin): “A mind flayer? Hopefully there's no truth to his ravings.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “Just a trick, surely. We're being toyed with.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “Probably another of the hag's mind games. Nothing more.”
  • (Lorin died after being forced out of his corner): “Looked like his heart gave out. I've seen it before.”
    • (Responding remark): “His heart gave out - with a little magical push, I'll wager.”
  • (Put on a Whispering Mask and saw through illusion): “Talk about appearances being deceiving...”
    • (Failed a  Wisdom save against Ethel’s mask): “Get out of my head at once!”
    • (Freed from Ethel’s masks mind control): “Ugh. I've enough trespassers in my head without her joining in the fun.”
    • (Other hag’s victims act neutral when wearing a Whispering Mask): “They're not attacking - thanks to the mask, no doubt.”
  • (Wandered into Ethel’s lair, the hag is not there): “The air's foul. What is this place?”
    • (Responding remark): “Keep your guard up. This place reeks of death.”
  • (Entered Acrid Workshop): “It's like an abattoir in here.”
    • (Responding remark): “A lot of unfortunates drew their final breath in here, I think.”
  • (After Ethel’s set Mayrina’s cage on fire): “She'll be roast like a goose if that fire isn't put out.”
  • (After resurrecting Connor Vinderblad): “Not quite the outcome we were expecting, is it?”
    • (Responding remark): “Forget it. The milk's already spilled.”

Blighted Village

  • (Spotted goblins' ambush upon entering the village): “Goblins ahead. Looks like they're laying an ambush.”

At the blacksmith's house and cellar:

  • (Picked up Selûnite Necklace in blacksmith’s house): “Moon witch rubbish. How much time did some dimwitted artisan waste on that?”
    • (If the party does not know she’s a Sharran): “Not to my tastes, certainly...”
  • (Found blacksmith's blueprints): "Plans. Looks like someone was intending to forge weapons."
    • (Responding remark): "Not too refined here - just quick ideas sketched out."
    • (Found another set of blueprints on the wall near the smithy): “More plans. Must be from the same blacksmith.”
    • (Responding remark, if already knows about adding Sussur Tree Bark): “These don't mention sussur bark though. Perhaps an earlier draft.”
  • (Added sussur bark to the melting forge, has read blueprints): “Right. Now I need to add a greatsword, sickle, or a dagger.”
    • (Hasn’t seen blueprints): “All right. What comes next?”
    • (If has read apprentice’s journal, but hasn’t seen blueprints): “These weapons sound worth forging... if I can find the design.”
  • (Found a crumbling wall in the cellar): “This wall's ready to tumble.”

In the Whispering Depths:

  • (After climbing down the well rope,  Survival check):
    • (Successful): "Best not touch these webs or I'll end up as a meal."
    • (Failed): "You could spin a cloak from all these cobwebs."
    • (Touched the web and heard Ettercap's shriek): "Sounds like something's less than pleased…"
  • (Felt air motion from the deeper pit): “Endless dark. Transfixing, isn't it? Who knows what's down there.”
    • (Responding remark): “Mind your footing. The bones of the careless are probably littered down there.”

In the Apothecary's Cellar:

  • (Upon entering the secret cellar): “Hmm. What might be tucked away in here?”
  • (Found the tome): “'The Necromancy of Thay'? Not a children's book, I assume.”
  • (If the party knows about Gale’s needs): “ 'The Necromancy of Thay'? Not a children's book, I assume. Gale may want it though.”
    • (If the tome was destroyed): “Hmm. Probably wise of you to get rid of that thing.”

The deal with Lump the Enlightened:

  • (Blowing Lump's War Horn, if the ogres are dead): “Can't summon any ogres now. Not unless this horn has necromantic properties...”
  • (Responding remark): “Doesn't matter how loud the horn's blown - dead ogres can't hear it.”
  • (Blowing the horn, while staying at the camp): “Hmm. Probably best to not have ogres traipsing through the camp, come to think of it...”
  • (Blowing the horn, if the ogres are too far away to hear it): “No sense in bursting my lungs on this horn - the ogres are too far away to hear it.”
  • (Blowing the horn, if deal with the ogres is done): “A waste of breath. The ogres won't answer this thing anymore.”

Elsewhere in the village:

  • (Found a hopscotch game): "Looks familiar… did I play this once? Long ago…?"
  • (After killing Grukkoh and Buthir): “An ogre and a bugbear. Not an eyeful I'd care to experience twice.”
    • (Responding remark): “Let's just put this behind us. Far behind us.”
  • (Found the Curious Book): “Hmm. Seems like someone liked their books to have a twist.”
    • (Responding remark): “Squeeze a silk blanket in there and you'd have all the makings of a pleasant evening.”
  • (Picked up the Old Schoolbook): "Someone's diary. Might explain what happened here."

Goblin Camp

At the gate and in the outer camp:

  • (After any party member  knocked a rhythm on a War Drum near the outer gate): "That should alert a good few goblins to our presence. Not planning on discretion, then?"
  • (After any party member smeared worg dung on their face): "I'd rather have a second tadpole than do that."
  • (Walking among the celebrating goblins): “We have to find Halsin before it's too late. I doubt these goblins care much for their prisoners' welfare.”
    • (Responding remark): “Let's keep an eye out - and hope he's still drawing breath when we find him.”
